throughput.source_quote: Delta Petroleum Corporation is an E&P company; no crude refining throughput

warnings: CAUTION: This CIK (821483) was Delta Petroleum Corporation (E&P company) in this period, not a petroleum refiner. No open derivative positions at December 31, 2011 (confirmed by Item 7A). Company was in bankruptcy reorganization period. Late filing (August 2012 for December 2011 fiscal year end). This entity would later become Par Petroleum Corporation, then acquire Hawaii refinery in September 2013.
